metadata.task: Close the medicine cabinet after placing the thermometer inside.

plan.goal: Place the thermometer into the medicine cabinet and then close the cabinet door.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the Pharmacy Zone and locate the Medicine Cabinet containing the Thermometer.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at Main Entrance. Thermometer is located in the Medicine Cabinet (Pharmacy Zone). Medicine Cabinet door is closed.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is positioned at the Medicine Cabinet in the Pharmacy Zone. Robot has detected the Medicine Cabinet and the Thermometer inside.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must navigate to the Pharmacy zone to access the Medicine Cabinet.
Robot must detect the thermometer to plan the pick action.
Robot must detect the medicine cabinet door to plan the close action.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Pick up the thermometer from the medicine cabinet.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Medicine Cabinet in the Pharmacy Zone. Thermometer is inside the cabinet. Door is closed.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is holding the thermometer. Thermometer is no longer inside the cabinet.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must open the medicine cabinet (treated as a drawer) to access the thermometer.
Robot must grasp and pick up the thermometer from the cabinet.

checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the thermometer. Medicine cabinet door is open.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is holding the thermometer. Medicine cabinet door is closed.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must close the medicine cabinet door to complete the task.

constraints: Robot is fixed-base; cannot navigate physically. Navigation is simulated via remote operation commands to the pharmacy location.
Robot lacks visual perception; object detection relies on pre-mapped semantic knowledge or simulated detection.

execution_summary.expected_outcome: Robot successfully simulates navigation to the Pharmacy, detects the medicine cabinet and thermometer, opens the cabinet, picks the thermometer, and closes the cabinet.
